summary:
The bakery puts its gable end to the street on a narrow plan. The ground storey is dark deepslate brick with a shop window and fold-down counter on each side of the door. Above it, a white half-timbered storey framed in stripped spruce juts out over the street, under a steep slate roof with a flour-loft hoist beam at its peak. A lower cobbled-deepslate bakehouse wing on the east holds the brick oven, which bulges out at the back under a tall red chimney. Narrow gable-to-street Germanic bakery: dark deepslate ground storey, jettied stripped-spruce Fachwerk upper storey with white wool daub, steep slate roof, hoist beam, and a cobbled-deepslate bakehouse wing with a brick barrel-vault oven under a smoking chimney.
Written: elements.md (checklist with constructions), and PALETTE (ids checked), VOCABULARY (41 helpers), ROOMS (6 with boxes), PARTS (6) and Notes appended to plan.md.
Stairs rise north in the SW corner from the Backstube to the Stube; the attic is reached by a ladder, and the oven has a hollow flue for its two campfires.

Massing and shell: parts/shell.mjs builds the sidewalk, deepslate ground storey, floors, stair housing, partitions, jettied half-timber storey, gable frames and wing walls. 1063 cells placed with no refused writes and no off-palette blocks. The build is unfinished: make.sh stops because roof.json (written by the Roofs part) is missing, so no whole build.nbt exists yet.
polish: make.sh exits before writing build.nbt because roof.json is missing; the Roofs part must write it. build.next.nbt (shell only, 1735 cells) rendered and passed mcd check.
mcd walk and mcd light were not run; they need the openings filled and the roof in.
mcd check reports 4 orphan collar-beam ends at (8,14,8), (14,14,8), (8,14,22), (14,14,22). The roof should support them.
Wing gable wool at z=13 covers x=18..20 at y=6..7, which may collide with the roof tool's slope cells; the Roofs part should check.
Left unset on purpose: all openings, the Mann brace cells, the shop breast cells (7..9,2,9) and (13..15,2,9), and the oven mouth. Yard patches are for the yard part.
Stairs, floors and partitions were not walk-tested.

summary:
room: Mehlboden (flour loft): Mehlboden (flour loft) furnished in parts/room-6.mjs with layers() over three y-layers (20 blocks): stair stack (11,12..14) with deck (11,14,9), hay sacks and flour barrels along the walls, and four lanterns on fence posts and barrels, the focal lantern at (12,13,11) by the stair foot.
Walk from the real ladder exit (10,12,20): 63 of 65 floor cells reached (the 2 unreached are furniture cells), min light 9, 0 dark cells; no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes. A temp build with the same code gives 1755 cells.
make.sh did not write build.nbt: it stops at the roof step because roof.json (Roofs part) is missing. My part is built; the whole-build make needs the Roofs part first.
polish: make.sh stops at the roof step (roof.json missing, written by the Roofs part), so build.nbt is not rewritten; rerun make.sh once Roofs lands.
Real ladder exit is (10,12,20), not (9,12,20): the hole at (9,11,20) gives no floor under (9,12,20). Noted in plan.md NOTES FOR WORKERS; Schlafkammer/shell should not build a landing at (9,12,20).
mcd room uses rooms.json's entrance (the front door), so the loft reads 'no way in' until the stairs and ladder exist; I checked with a temp rooms file at [10,12,20] in /tmp/loft-check.
Headroom under the roof slope is not verified: the roof is still a stub in this copy, so mcd room cannot see the slope; check after Roofs lands.
Render (room.png) shows only the shell, because the roof is still a stub, so the look check of the loft is partial; re-render after the Roofs merge.
elements.md 'Interior' item and the room's workstation/bed items are not ticked: the flour loft has no beds or bench and the shared interior item covers all six rooms.

summary:
inspection: Walk now ok for all 6 rooms (was Mehlboden unreachable). Root cause: roof strip after the parts removed the attic floor, the loft furniture and the bedroom lanterns, and the attic ladder was never called by any part. Replaced the ladder with a walkable stair up x=10, kept the attic interior in roof.json's keep list, moved the bedroom barrel and rug off the stair.
make.sh passes, walk ok, no dark cells, no refused writes or off-palette blocks in parts-report.json.
polish: Plan deviation: plan.md specifies an attic ladder at (9,7..11,20) with backing (9,7..10,21); the built attic access is now a straight stair up the x=10 column (10,7..11,17..21) with the loft hole at (10,11,18..20). Update plan.md and the Mehlboden/Schlafkammer notes to match. The ladder cannot be walk-verified because mcd walk never counts a ladder cell as standable.
Unused kit code: vocab.mjs atticLadder() and ATTIC_LADDER are no longer called by any part; ATTIC_HOLE still describes the old x=8..9 hole. Remove or update in the kit.

Roof: the strip step runs after the parts, so any part cell above the eave (y>=10) inside the footprint must be listed in MAIN_ROOF_SPEC.keep. Three keep boxes were added; a future part that builds above y=10 will lose its cells unless it is also listed.
Roof: mcd roof reports ROOF_BIG_PLANE (17-cell unbroken slope, no dormer or chimney) and builds roof top y=20 against plan.md's y=21. Not touched; it is the roof design, not a between-parts gap.
Check reports 3 orphans: spruce_planks at (19,8,12) and (19,8,23) are wing-roof ridge end caps poking out past the gable; barrel (11,16,5) hangs from a chain, which is intended. Not touched.

Walk still lists unreached standable cells on top of counter/shelf furniture (shop 13,4,13 / 14,4,13 / 14,4,14; Backstube 7,4,21; bakehouse 18,4,14 / 20,4,21; bedroom 15,9,18 / 15,9,19). Those are furniture tops, not floor, and every room verdict is ok, so left as they are.
Bedroom has one dim cell (light 7) at the stair foot area; no dark cells. Light lantern suggested at (9,8,17) is optional.

waste.what: Found the missing attic floor by probing cells one at a time (cells.mjs) and then printing x-z sections by hand (column.mjs) to see where the roof shell was and what the strip removed.
waste.cost: about 20 single-cell probes and 3 section dumps before the cause was clear
waste.tool: mcd roof --dry-run should list the built cells it would strip (y>=eave inside the footprint, minus keep) with a per-part breakdown; mcd section <nbt> --z 15 --y 0,22 would replace hand-written column dumps

waste.what: Worked out by trial that mcd walk needs two cells of headroom above each standing cell, and that a ladder is passable but never standable; the walk verdict only said 'no way in' and gave no reason.
waste.cost: 3 rebuild/walk cycles to find the headroom rule, plus one ladder-versus-stair decision by reading the walk source
waste.tool: mcd walk / mcd room should name the blocking cell and rule for each unreached region (for example 'blocked headroom at 10,11,20' or 'ladder not standable'), and mcd room should print the stair/ladder cells it passes through

waste.what: Computed the stair cells, fill blocks, hole cells and the cells that had to be cleared in the bedroom and loft by hand, cell by cell.
waste.cost: about 40 coordinates written by hand, two rug/barrel moves in room-5 and a corrected rug column
waste.tool: a stair-run helper in the build library (run from (x,y0,z0) along an axis for n steps, filling supports and listing the headroom cells that must stay air)
